title: Manual and Digital Stock-Check Worksheets
summary: Adds printable and iPad-friendly live inventory worksheets for Pantry Staples, Freezer Inventory, and the Master Shopping List.
behavior: Prints every Pantry Staple with In Stock, quantity, Need, and notes fields.
Prints every default and custom Freezer Inventory item with stock and storage-detail fields.
Prints the current Master Shopping List with In Stock, Buy, quantity, and notes fields.
Opens each worksheet in a clean print window without changing saved kitchen data.
Provides a large-control Digital Stock Check mode suitable for an iPad on all three pages.
Updates Pantry Staples, Freezer Inventory, and Shopping List checks live while the worksheet is open.
Stores digital quantities and notes locally and includes them in the full-site Backup & Restore file for transfer between devices.
